stem: Which detail best supports the idea that the mission of Hot Bread Kitchen has public support?

options.label: A
options.text: Rodriguez had to move the business from her apartment to La Marqueta.

options.label: B
options.text: Charitable contributions help fund the bakery's training program.

options.label: C
options.text: Entrepreneurs rent space from the bakery to run their businesses.

options.label: D
options.text: Some of the bakery's former trainees now hold managerial positions.
